description: Searches Book 1 of the Belgian AREI/RGIE (Royal Decree on electrical installations) in the language of the text: Dutch, French or German; English uses the German text. Returns up to ten articles with number, title, an excerpt, the edition in force today and a link to the article in the PlanElec reader; the full article text is not returned, use get_regelwerk_article for it. Search by keywords or by article number such as 4.2.4.3. Results are planning aids, not an official inspection.

locale.description: Language of source titles and links (nl, fr, de, en). Defaults to the server setting.

query.description: Keywords or an article number such as 5.2.2.1 or 4.2.4.3, 2–120 characters.

version.description: Optional edition, e.g. v06 or v07. Default: the edition in force today (v06 until 31/10/2026, v07 from 01/11/2026).

name: search_regelwerk
title: Search the Belgian AREI/RGIE regulations
